title: A Parade of Horribles
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: A newer book in the Dungeon Crawler Carl series, in which a man and his former pet cat are forced to survive a deadly televised dungeon built by aliens. It continues the series' mix of black comedy and brutal action.
readIf: you're already deep into the series and want another round of its jokes and mayhem.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since this series should be read in order.

pairings.reason: A lighter, nostalgic game-world adventure if you like the levels and loot side of the series.
A classic comic sci-fi with the same sense of ordinary people tossed into a ridiculous universe.
A shorter, wittier sci-fi about expendable characters who figure out they are living in a story.
